messages:
jess: pagerbot fired an alert — svc-proxy-03 showing sustained high-volume outbound POSTs to an external S3 bucket (03:12 UTC). looks like forwards from internal log-forwarder. paging oncall.
pagerbot: INCIDENT OPENED: INC-2026-112 — severity: P1. channels: #incidents, ops-bridge. summary: svc-proxy egress spike -> external s3.
omar (sre-oncall): acknowledged. pulling recent proxy logs now. can someone confirm customer impact surface?
jess: initial check: forwarded payloads are ~200–300KB each, ~800 req/min. likely a misconfigured forwarder but could be exfil. no 5xx to customers yet.
omar (sre-oncall): cordoning node: `kubectl cordon svc-proxy-03` and scaling down forwarder job. applying egress-deny for that pod IP now.
infra-bot: applied network policy deny-egress to pod svc-proxy-03 (10.42.7.19) — ruleset id np-deny-6043.
omar (sre-oncall): network block in place. traffic dropped. still seeing S3 PUTs from a different service account token in logs before block.
mike (eng): grabbing raw log snippets, suspect forwarder conf changed yesterday during deploy. snippet:
```
"time":"2026-03-18T03:09:51Z" "src":"svc-forwarder" "dest":"https://s3.amazonaws.com/rdw-exports/abcd.tar.gz" "auth":"Bearer eyJr..."
```
rachel (sec): tagging this sec-sensitive. @legal-team FYI. what's the artifact scope? any customer PII in those blobs?
jess: unknown yet — forwarder ships compressed logs. starting targeted S3 HEAD requests to see object metadata, will not download yet, to avoid further exposure.
omar (sre-oncall): confirm: we rotated IAM role for forwarder yesterday? deploy notes show role swap but keys may still be valid for old token.
mike (eng): role swap was deployed but we left the old token in k8s secret due to rollout rollback safety. that secret likely got picked up by new job — ugh.
rachel (sec): action list: 1) rotate secrets/keys, 2) suspend S3 write permissions for role, 3) snapshot list of objects and preserve for forensics, 4) customer impact assessment.
omar (sre-oncall): already kicked off key rotation for service account: `kubectl patch secret forwarder-creds -p ...` and requested IAM revoke for inline creds. waiting on IAM API response.
infra-bot: IAM revoke request submitted (req-78901). estimated completion ~30s.
legal-team: please preserve evidence. do NOT delete or modify suspect S3 objects. we'll need object headers and hashes. if exfil confirmed, we need timeline for notification.
jess: collected object list via HEAD: 27 objects created between 02:58–03:15 UTC in rdw-exports/temporary/. mime-type text/plain, some names indicate rotated logs: `proxy.access.2026-03-18.tar.gz`.
mike (eng): grabbing sample headers and hashes now. will upload MD5/SHA256 to the incident ticket, not the channel.
omar (sre-oncall): IAM revoke succeeded. old token shows revoked at 03:22 UTC. confirm no new outbound PUTs after 03:21.
pagerbot: incident status update — mitigation: egress blocked, creds revoked. collecting telemetry, forensics in progress.
rachel (sec): customer impact: so far no inbound 5xx and no customer traffic errors. potential data exposure: unknown until we inspect archives. start prep for affected-customer list.
jess: triage note: likely cause = stale secret left in k8s secret mount + recent forwarder redeploy. root cause investigation assigned to mike.
mike (eng): reproducing locally — can confirm that if old secret present and new role active, forwarder will happily push to any configured bucket. pushing full audit of deploy pipeline to ticket.
legal-team: we'll standby. if PII found we need to notify SOC and affected customers per policy. sec, start scoping customer list and draft initial notification templates.
rachel (sec): agreed. next steps: 1) preserve objects (done), 2) gather which tenants appear in logs, 3) scope customers, 4) exec/PR comms channel.
omar (sre-oncall): handing off to night oncall @jess for follow-up. I'm logging this as oncall-handoff in the ticket. if anything new surfaces ping me.
jess: taking over. will coordinate post-rotate verification and customer scoping. posting a short action checklist to ticket and scheduling a 20-min bridge with legal & sec in 15.
legal-team: please include retention flags and whether objects are encrypted at rest (SSE-S3/SSE-KMS). need to know KMS key usage.
mike (eng): objects show SSE-S3; no KMS key used on upload. adding that to ticket.
jess: quick summary for channel: mitigation in place (egress block + creds revoked). forensics ongoing. oncall handover to jess. legal & sec engaged. will update within 30m. :rotating_light:
pagerbot: incident severity downgraded to P1-monitoring as egress is contained but forensics active. next update 03:45 UTC.
